title: Aggressive pruning: online_delete 256 over 600 ledgers
severity_reason: Pruning deletes exactly as configured and the node keeps serving every requested ledger because a full-history peer exists. The availability cost appears only when no such peer exists (see S2).
notes: Advisory delete is OFF, so can_delete stays at the UINT32_MAX default and rotation is gated only by the interval, the validated age, and FULL mode (SHAMapStoreImp.cpp:331-344). The RPC fetches include ledgers below the new minimumOnline to show they are served only through a peer acquire.
